# LogoPack

> LogoPack supplies custom printed paper cups, coffee cup sleeves, paper takeout bags and paper sleeve bags for coffee shops, cafés, restaurants, bakeries and food trucks. Based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. Contact: logopackca@gmail.com. Website: https://logopack.ca

Customers send their logo, products and rough quantities; LogoPack replies with a quote and a digital proof before anything is printed.

## Products

- [Custom paper cups](https://logopack.ca/custom-paper-cups/): Hot and cold paper cups printed with your logo, in the sizes your menu uses.
- [Coffee cup sleeves](https://logopack.ca/coffee-cup-sleeves/): Branded sleeves that turn plain cups into your cups, and protect hands from heat.
- [Paper takeout bags](https://logopack.ca/paper-bags/): Kraft and white paper bags with handles, printed with your logo for takeout and delivery.
- [Paper sleeve bags](https://logopack.ca/paper-sleeve-bags/): Flat paper sleeve bags for sandwiches, pastries and baked goods, with your logo.

## Contact
